list.name: target_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, target_id AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY target_id

list.name: advisor_group
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') AS __value, coalesce(advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: priority
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(priority, 'UNKNOWN') AS __value, coalesce(priority, 'UNKNOWN') AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: risk_level
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') AS __value, coalesce(risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: finding_fingerprint
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT finding_fingerprint AS __value, coalesce(title, finding_fingerprint) AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY 2

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT g.*
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${risk_level:sqlstring})
    AND g.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding_fingerprint:sqlstring})
)
SELECT max(collected_at) FROM filtered;

panels.title: Latest findings for selected target(s)

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT g.*
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${risk_level:sqlstring})
    AND g.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding_fingerprint:sqlstring})
),
latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id)
      target_id,
      run_id,
      collected_at
  FROM filtered
  ORDER BY target_id, collected_at DESC
),
current_findings AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    ON ls.target_id = f.target_id
   AND ls.run_id = f.run_id
)
SELECT
  target_id,
  rank_position,
  priority,
  risk_level,
  advisor_group,
  category_id,
  action_type,
  action_safety,
  requires_lock,
  requires_maintenance_window,
  object_type,
  schema_name,
  table_name,
  column_name,
  index_name,
  title,
  recommendation_note,
  improvement_sql
FROM current_findings
ORDER BY
  CASE priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
  CASE risk_level WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
  rank_position DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;

panels.title: Findings count over time by priority

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('${bucket:raw}', g.collected_at) AS time,
  coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') AS metric,
  count(*) AS findings
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
  AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${risk_level:sqlstring})
  AND g.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding_fingerprint:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Recurring findings in selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  target_id,
  finding_fingerprint,
  min(collected_at) AS first_seen,
  max(collected_at) AS last_seen,
  count(DISTINCT run_id) AS occurrences,
  max(priority) AS priority,
  max(risk_level) AS risk_level,
  max(advisor_group) AS advisor_group,
  max(category_id) AS category_id,
  max(object_type) AS object_type,
  max(object_name) AS object_name,
  max(title) AS title,
  max(recommendation_note) AS recommendation_note
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
  AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${risk_level:sqlstring})
  AND g.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding_fingerprint:sqlstring})
GROUP BY target_id, finding_fingerprint
ORDER BY occurrences DESC, max(rank_position) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;

panels.title: New findings in selected time range

targets.rawSql:
WITH first_seen AS (
  SELECT
    target_id,
    finding_fingerprint,
    min(collected_at) AS first_seen_at
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot
  GROUP BY target_id, finding_fingerprint
)
SELECT
  g.collected_at,
  g.target_id,
  g.priority,
  g.risk_level,
  g.advisor_group,
  g.category_id,
  g.object_type,
  g.object_name,
  g.title,
  g.recommendation_note
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
JOIN first_seen fs
  ON fs.target_id = g.target_id
 AND fs.finding_fingerprint = g.finding_fingerprint
 AND fs.first_seen_at = g.collected_at
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
  AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${risk_level:sqlstring})
  AND g.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding_fingerprint:sqlstring})
ORDER BY g.collected_at DESC, g.rank_position DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Resolved findings in selected time range

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.target_id)
      g.target_id,
      g.run_id,
      g.collected_at
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${risk_level:sqlstring})
    AND g.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding_fingerprint:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY g.target_id, g.collected_at DESC
),
historical_findings AS (
  SELECT
    g.target_id,
    g.finding_fingerprint,
    max(g.collected_at) AS last_seen_at,
    max(g.priority) AS priority,
    max(g.risk_level) AS risk_level,
    max(g.advisor_group) AS advisor_group,
    max(g.category_id) AS category_id,
    max(g.title) AS title
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.risk_level, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${risk_level:sqlstring})
    AND g.finding_fingerprint IN (${finding_fingerprint:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY g.target_id, g.finding_fingerprint
),
current_findings AS (
  SELECT g.target_id, g.finding_fingerprint
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    ON ls.target_id = g.target_id
   AND ls.run_id = g.run_id
)
SELECT
  h.last_seen_at,
  h.target_id,
  h.priority,
  h.risk_level,
  h.advisor_group,
  h.category_id,
  h.title
FROM historical_findings h
LEFT JOIN current_findings c
  ON c.target_id = h.target_id
 AND c.finding_fingerprint = h.finding_fingerprint
WHERE c.finding_fingerprint IS NULL
ORDER BY h.last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 100;
